We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) based on facts. The facts: defendant contracted renovation, took 22 million? Actually 24 million? He took 22 million of the contract money, left, owes workers 57,000 for wages. He was ordered to pay, he escaped, refused to pay, later paid after police case. So likely charge: "拒不支付劳动报酬" maybe "拒不支付劳动报酬罪" under Chinese law (failure to pay wages). Also possibly "非法占有" theft? He took money from employer? He was contractor, got payment for work, but didn't pay workers. That's not theft of the employer's money; it's misappropriation of funds? Could be "诈骗" (fraud) if he obtained money by false pretenses. He contracted, got payment, but didn't fulfill obligations. That could be "合同诈骗罪" (contract fraud). Under Chinese criminal law, if a person obtains property by fraudulent means through contract, it's contract fraud. He got 22 million from the client? Actually he got 22 million from the client (owner of the restaurant) for renovation, but didn't complete? He completed but didn't pay workers. He left after receiving payment. He may have defrauded the client? The client paid 22 million for renovation; he completed? It says "工程结束时，查某某陆续领取工程款22万元后离开集安". So he completed the work, but then left without paying workers. So not fraud on client. The workers are owed wages. The crime is "拒不支付劳动报酬罪" (failure to pay wages). Also possibly "非法占有" but not typical. The Chinese criminal law article 275: "用人单位克扣或者不支付劳动者的劳动报酬，情节严重的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金。" That's a crime. So charge: "拒不支付劳动报酬". Also maybe "逃匿" but that's not a crime separate. The fact he escaped after being ordered to pay, but later paid. Could be "逃避支付劳动报酬" but same.

Thus single charge: 拒不支付劳动报酬.
